newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN DIPLOMAT RELEASED BY PERU REBELS.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN DIPLOMAT RELEASED BY PERU REBELS.

text.p: Romanian charge d'affaires Octavian Filip, taken hostage by the leftist Peruvian rebels in Lima last week, was freed on Sunday, Bucharest radio said.

The raio said Filip was released together with other 224 diplomats whom the leftist Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement had taken hostages at the Japanese embassy in the Peruvian capital last Wenesday.
The diplmats were attending ceremonies marking the birthday of Japan's Emperor when rebels stormed the embassy building.

The rebels said they released the non-government hostages as a "Christmas gesture" but they still retain 140 people. They warned the remaining captives will not be released unless the Peruvian government freed their jailed comrades.
